name: Loverendia.
source:
Loverendia. is a short visual novel where Arán, planning to die and on the verge of madness, meets a girl named Laira.

[From [url=https://eroraen.itch.io/loverendia]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
洛夫伦迪亚。是一部短篇视觉小说，其中阿兰计划死亡并处于疯狂的边缘，遇到了一个名叫莱拉的女孩。

[来自[url=https://eroraen.itch.io/loverendia]Itch.io[/url]]
